dog.description_text: Meet Peach, the sweetest little addition to your family! This 2-month-old Shepherd/Terrier mix was rescued with her two sisters after they were dropped off at our partner shelter in Kentucky. Now she has a whole new life ahead of her! Peach is a loving, playful puppy who can learn to live with kids, other dogs, and cats with gentle introductions and guidance. At her young age, she’s ready to grow alongside a family who can give her the time, training, and love every puppy needs. Peach has been spayed, vetted, and has started her puppy vaccine series. Apply to adopt her at rescuecity.nyc/adopt.
dog.name: Peach
